tools.name: get_parcel
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK or street address: zoning and its dimensional rules, State Land Use District, flood zone, Special Management Area, tsunami and sea level rise, lava zone and slope, each with its source. Answers questions about one Hawaiʻi lot, by TMK or street

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a short 3D video (MP4) of one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK, drawn from public lidar with the lot line on the ground.

tools.name: get_listing_facts
tools.description: Use this when an agent is writing or checking a Hawaiʻi listing and needs the lot facts with their sources, by TMK or street address. It writes nothing itself.

tools.name: search_lots
tools.description: Use this when someone wants nearby Hawaiʻi lots that fit zoning, size, flood zone or Special Management Area filters, around a lot, an address or a TMK prefix.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_parcel" is 1271 chars, far longer than this server's median (159). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
